authority.claim_limit: This pre-sign contract prepares a reviewable Stage-1C v2 mapping protocol. It grants no research recoding, CURRENT activation, empirical execution or novelty authority.

paper_audit_contract.non_empirical_rule: A non-empirical work becomes an evidence node; no conceptual experiment cell may be fabricated.

experiment_cell_contract.metric_rule: Multiple metrics from one run configuration are observations on one cell, not duplicate cells.
experiment_cell_contract.comparison_rule: Cross-paper numeric comparison requires an exact comparability key over dataset revision, split, core model and revision, access protocol, input condition, metric and budget horizon.

dataset_graph_contract.lineage_rule: Every lineage edge requires traceable source evidence; semantic similarity alone is never lineage.
dataset_graph_contract.relation_rule: Every non-lineage relation requires a bounded rationale and evidence mode.

experiment_family_contract.core_rule: CORE_MEMBER cells match the complete core signature. Dataset lineage may differ but remains a visible result stratum.
experiment_family_contract.related_rule: Validation, transfer, falsifier and instrument evidence attach by typed edges and do not inherit direct comparability.
experiment_family_contract.result_synthesis: Results are stratified by dataset lineage and access before assigning one controlled family evidence state.
experiment_family_contract.innovation_semantics: Separate author-claimed contribution, within-paper experimental support and project residual hypothesis; project novelty verdict remains prohibited.

local_protocol_contract.generation_rule: Every LOCAL_READY family and every locally closable LOCAL_ADAPTABLE family receives an unexecuted protocol.

branch_contract.candidate_strategy_limit: Freeze inputs, state, signals, decision rights, actions and expected causal path only; do not freeze or claim a novel algorithm.

review_contract.blind_review: at least 20 percent stratified by role, data and task
